title: Elements Ui App Mode Window Engagement
description: Reimplement Golden Layout-style docking in pure React Mode (tab stacks, resize, drag-dock, maximize, close; no persistence/popout). Restore golden-layout for sketchpad LayoutCanvas.
summary: Reimplemented Golden Layout-style docking in pure React inside Mode: tab stacks (one visible window per stack), resizable row/column splits via react-resizable-panels, pointer drag-to-reorder/move/split with drop indicators, stack maximize/restore, and per-tab close. Extended WindowLayoutStackNode.activeId and ModeWindowDescriptor.title; added layout tree utils. Removed dead Golden Layout header portal from Window. Wired tab titles through ShellModeCanvas in framework and playground renderers. Restored golden-layout dependency and .lm_* CSS for sketchpad. Added Mode vitest coverage and TabStack/MaximizeStack stories. Fixed vitest duplicate-run config and boardFixtureMetaKindCompatibility export. All vitest pass: @elements/ui (45), @elements/framework-react (7), @elements/playground (8).
